evidence_used: Market question: probability of OpenAI completing a $1T+ IPO before 2027
Microsoft's known large equity/economic stake in and partnership with OpenAI
Nvidia/semiconductor exposure as the primary AI-compute beneficiary complex
General principle that prediction-market probability shifts are noisy, indirect signals for large liquid equities over short windows
uncertainty_notes: No single publicly-traded pure-play proxy for OpenAI exists; MSFT is the closest but heavily diluted by its own business.
Direction is genuinely two-sided for Microsoft: an OpenAI IPO both crystallizes stake value and erodes exclusivity/control.
A 12h window is far too short to price an IPO event that resolves up to end-2026; any move is likely dominated by unrelated drivers.
700bps tradable threshold is very unlikely to be met by this indirect linkage.

llm_justification.summary: A sharp move in the OpenAI $1T+ IPO probability most plausibly maps to Microsoft (largest investor/partner) and secondarily to the AI/semiconductor complex, but both linkages are weak and directionally ambiguous over a 12h window. Microsoft would see its OpenAI stake re-rated, yet a public OpenAI could also dilute its preferential position, leaving a mixed net. The semis channel is pure sentiment. Expected magnitudes are well below the 700bps tradable threshold, so this is low-conviction, not-tradable research.
key_assumptions: Microsoft remains the dominant public-market proxy for OpenAI value.
A prediction-market probability shift precedes or accompanies real IPO/corporate-action news.
Mega-cap equities are only marginally sensitive to a multi-year-out IPO event over 12h.
failure_modes: The information may already be public (widely reported IPO speculation), so no leakage/edge exists.
Polymarket move could be thin-liquidity noise unrelated to any real event.
MSFT/SOXX are weak, diluted proxies dominated by macro and earnings drivers, swamping any OpenAI signal.
Direction could reverse: an OpenAI IPO could be read as negative for Microsoft's exclusivity, flipping the sign.
If OpenAI is instead acquired/restructured (market resolves No), the same proxies could move opposite to the naive read.
